brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full inside, cover:0,0,0;full;bottom (bolt type) as floor, six caps closing the side edges; check_build clear.
cover:0,0,0;full;top acts as the lid, with handle:0,0,0;top to lift it.

No magnet part exists in the catalog: find_parts for magnet/latch/catch/shut returned nothing; addCover rejected types magnet, magnetic, magnets, mag, neodymium, magnet-lid (INVALID_PART_ID); inserts offered are only blank, female, male, foot and zip. The lid is a standard cover and is not magnetically retained in this configuration.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell storage box: full hex base (0,0,0) with a full-depth bin, a bolt cover on the bottom, a top cover as the lid with a handle (plus its three auto-placed inserts), and caps on all six side edges. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear. The catalog has no magnet part (no magnetic cover type, insert, catch or latch), so the magnetic lid closure could not be configured.
